description: This PHP class defines the entity 'CompositeDisplayField' for an ORM system (Doctrine) within the OrangeHRM system. It extends AbstractDisplayField and includes ORM annotations for database mapping, properties for ID and related 'SelectedCompositeDisplayField' entities, and basic getter/setter methods.

classes.name: CompositeDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a composite display field, mapped to 'ohrm_composite_display_field' table, with a one-to-many relationship to SelectedCompositeDisplayField.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the composite display field.
